name: fintrack-pro-backend
description: Same layered structure as your job-tracker project — repository → service → controller → route — now on **Mongoose** (per the original project overview) instead of the native MongoDB driver, and scoped down to just what's built so far: **Transactions CRUD, Budgets CRUD, and Clerk-based auth.** Billing, receipts, analytics, and tax are deliberately not in this cut — add them back the same way these were built, when you're ready.
